SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the DX-3 Downtown Mixed-Use District and DS-3
Downtown Service District and symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-G in the
area bounded by:

         The south line of vacated West Arcade Place;

         West Monroe Street;
         A line 142.74 feet east of and parallel to South Racine Avenue


to those of DS-5 Downtov^n Service District, which is hereby established in the area above
